# DF Editor sections

<!-- Generated by `wp df docs`. Do not edit by hand: change section.json and re-run. -->

Field IDs on a page: `{page_key}.{instance_id}.{field}`, list items `{page_key}.{instance_id}.{list}.{n}.{field}` (n from 1).
Common layout options for every section: `scheme`, `spacing`, `width`, `hidden`, `anchor` (see docs/CONVENTIONS.md in df-blocks).
